shared_elements: figures rendered on a rock surface with no ground line
justification: Both surfaces present schematic humanoid figures reduced to outline bodies with head and limbs, without background or ground line, which is a generic correspondence rather than a distinctive shared motif. The specific forms differ markedly: A shows a single large crouching, hunched creature with a beaked/avian head, curved back and internal rib-like strokes, dominating the whole surface, while B shows several small linear stick-like standing figures with arms raised, accompanied by long straight lines, spread side by side across the field.
